description: Consumi Energia Elettrica utenze Comune di Genova (ComGE) is a dataset listed in Italian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Comune di Genova. Consumi annuali di energia elettrica realtivi alle utenze in capo al Comune di Genova con indicazione delle relative emissioni di CO2. Coverage: Comune di Genova. The portal files it under the publisher Comune di Genova. Its tags are consumi-energia-genova, consumi-energia-genova-elettricita, consumi-genova, elettricita, energia. It offers 4 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2026-02-28 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
